annotations.title: Next steps after a French legal notice

description: Use this when the user has published, or is about to publish, a legal notice and asks what comes next: the filing on the one-stop shop for business formalities (guichet unique, INPI), deadlines, what the court registry does (BODACC) and the documents to prepare for that formality. Do not use as a substitute for the official checklist shown by the one-stop shop when filing.
name: get_next_steps
title: Next steps after a French legal notice
